summary: Scotiabank filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release announcing that the TSX and OSFI approved an amendment to its normal course issuer bid, raising the authorized repurchase cap from 15 million to 40 million common shares for cancellation. The amended amount equals roughly 3.25% of the 1,231,433,660 shares outstanding as of March 24, 2026, effective October 6, 2026. Scotiabank had already bought 13,044,315 shares since the bid began. Purchases run until the earlier of the cap being reached, termination notice, or April 6, 2027, with daily limits of 1,114,002 shares; price is market-based.
